cs.t: As an owner of one of these pair of headphones, I'm trying to understand what this brings to my life? It's not clear why this app is specifically useful for sony headphones? The price seems quite high from what I can see it offers?
cs.th: Open Sound Connect – Control Sony Headphones from Your Mac

cs.t: I mostly use the square pins from SIL headers, bent into an appropriate shape. I use a pointed tip but I don't think it matters much, as long as it can transfer heat into the pin. I most recently used this to repair a snapped headband on some sony headphones. I'd previously tried to superglue it, but the glue eventually came undone - but my "staples" are still going strong.
cs.th: More sustainable epoxy thanks to phosphorus
